unverified.reason: branch_exempt: 4 track piece(s), path 8.9 mm <= 80.0 mm, width >= 0.5 mm left out of the PWR3A width and neck checks: fan switch Q304 source on LAB5: E3_FAN5 (Q304 drain to F301) is sized for the F102 4 A protective current (netclasses.json PWR3A, Q304 has no current limit), but the LAB5 feed of Q304 is the right-group branch through the 0.6 mm L3 run below: the deviation is recorded in build/15 "Гілки LAB5 на CTRL (W2 PCB-CTRL)" (CTRL-4 OPEN). LAB5 branch from the scripted 1.85 mm feed (J305.3 -> J314.2, F.Cu) to a low-current load. Measured on the routed board of route run 43206372346 (W2 CTRL-R): D306, C342 and C343 sit on short scripted pieces on the trunk side; the whole right group (the Pico VSYS diode D301, the GNSS switch U315 with C321/C322 and the fan switch Q304 with C320/R367) hangs from J314.2 on one path: 7.9 mm of 0.6 mm B.Cu (LAB5-D306) to the via LAB5-V-D306, 19.9 mm of 0.6 mm L3 (In2.Cu, 0.5 oz = 0.0152 mm; LAB5-L3-D301) to the via LAB5-V-D301 at D301, then 0.5 mm locked router copper (33.9 mm shared by U315 and Q304, 35.3 mm to Q304 in all: 30.2 mm F.Cu, 5.1 mm B.Cu) and the 0.6 mm B.Cu piece LAB5-FAN/LAB5-Q304 (9.6 mm) to Q304.2; J305.3 to Q304.2 is 91.9 mm of copper. Without the L3 run LAB5 splits into {J305, J314.2, D306, C342, C343} and {D301, U315, C321, C322, Q304, R367, C320}. Loads on the L3 run: fan 0.25 A (E3_FAN5 continuous, tools/assembly_data.py NET_CURRENT via pcb/generated/netclasses.json), U315 0.10 A continuous budget and 0.144-0.192 A limit (RILIM 162k), Pico VSYS (not in NET_CURRENT: TBD), capacitors no DC current: 0.35 A continuous plus VSYS, 0.44 A plus VSYS at the U315 limit. IPC-2221 internal (k 0.024, 0.6 x 0.0152 mm = 14.1 mil2; MODEL): the L3 run carries 0.45 A at +10 degC, 0.54 A at +15 degC and 0.61 A at +20 degC (+5.6 degC at 0.35 A, +9.6 degC at 0.44 A); 0.5 mm of 1 oz outer copper carries about 1.45 A at +10 degC (IPC-2221 external, k 0.048). A short at the end of a branch (a capacitor failing short, the E3_FAN5 node between Q304 and F301, a fault behind D301) drives the current of the upstream fuse F102 (4 A, holds its rating): about +100 degC on 0.5 mm outer copper and far outside the formula on the L3 run, which would fuse (the PWR3A rule needs 1.3348 mm outer at 4 A and +20 degC). Recorded layout deviation from the PWR3A sizing of netclasses.json, CTRL-4 OPEN with ranked closure options (build/15 "Гілки LAB5 на CTRL (W2 PCB-CTRL)" and "CTRL-4: живлення правої групи LAB5 (W2 CTRL-R)"); not a bench gate
